test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate op on to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**boosts**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage emphasizes the positive impact sports have, not only on physical fitness but also on mental attributes like concentration and inner strength. "Boosts" fits perfectly as it indicates improvement or enhancement.
 
• "Boosts" means to increase or strengthen, which aligns with the idea that sports help improve concentration and inner strength.
 
• Other options such as "deteriorates" (weakens), "controls" (manages), and "underlines" (highlights) do not fit with the context of enhancing mental and physical capabilities through sports.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *In the contemporary times, sports and games are emerging as one of the brightest careers. It expects to ___1___ at a very high moral plane. It demands honesty and transparency. Sports further demand continuous practice, hard work and ___2___ training. One must understand that sport not only has physical benefits but also boosts__ concentration and inner strength. Not only this, one who plays feels that ____4___ overall personality has undergone a change for better. Besides, social connectivity or networking, games develop ___5___ spirit in players.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Deteriorates (बिगड़ना): "Deteriorates" means to worsen, which contradicts the context of enhancing concentration and strength through sports.
 
• Controls (नियंत्रित करना): "Controls" means to regulate, which does not convey the idea of improvement or enhancement as well as "boosts" does.
 
• Underlines (रेखांकित करना): "Underlines" means to emphasize, but it does not suggest the positive enhancement of concentration and strength that sports provide.
